concerns.text: Task T025d specifies a fallback to 1,000 permutation shuffles if runtime exceeds 6 h, which weakens FR-005 that requires 10,000 shuffles. No deviation documentation or ratification is provided, violating the constraint that functional requirements must not be silently relaxed.

Task T025b_spatial mirrors T025d’s fallback to 1,000 shuffles for spatial shift vectors, also weakening FR-005 without a recorded deviation. This constitutes an unapproved weakening of the specification.
